description.value: Frontcountry campground in Yoho National Park set in mountain forest near distinctive hoodoo rock formations; a national park entry pass and camping permit are both required, and mountain weather can deliver rain or snow even in midsummer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is Parks Canada's frontcountry camping page for Yoho National Park covering all four campgrounds; the fetched content was truncated before reaching the Hoodoo Creek anchor section (#hoodoocreek), so campground-specific amenity details are unavailable. General park-wide information confirms reservations are accepted online and by phone, and that food must be secured in vehicles or hard-sided RVs (cyclist-specific storage not addressed). The campground is confirmed active for the 2026 season based on current reservation launch details on the page.
concerns: Website content was truncated before reaching the Hoodoo Creek-specific anchor section (#hoodoocreek); campground-specific amenity details (showers, hiker/biker sites, potable water, etc.) could not be confirmed from the fetched content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Hoodoo Creek is a legitimate Parks Canada frontcountry campground in Yoho National Park on a major cycling corridor in the Canadian Rockies; it is a clear fit for the WWC touring directory.
